summary: Helm uninstall steps: remove templates using `ansible:content:create`, delete the Ansible plug-in entries (OCI or plugin-registry URLs) under `plugins`, remove the ansible-devtools-server `extraContainers`, click Upgrade, delete the `ansible` section from `app-config-rhdh`, and restart RHDH.
questions: Steps to remove Ansible plug-ins from the Developer Hub Helm chart
Do I need to remove the extraContainers section when uninstalling?
Which ConfigMap section do I delete when removing the Ansible plug-ins?

answer_card.title: Uninstall the Ansible plug-ins (Helm)
answer_card.answer_md:
1. Remove templates that use the `ansible:content:create` action.
2. Helm > developer-hub > Upgrade > YAML: delete the two Ansible `plugins` entries and the `ansible-devtools-server` `extraContainers` entry; click **Upgrade**.
3. Delete the `ansible:` block from `app-config-rhdh` and restart RHDH.
4. Clean up: `oc delete secret <deployment-name>-dynamic-plugins-registry-auth` (OCI) or `oc delete all -l app=plugin-registry` (HTTP registry).
